label: USA PATRIOT Act — Internet Routing Information Added to Pen Register Coverage
provisions_amended: 18 U.S.C. §3127(3) — pen register definition expanded to 'dialing, routing, addressing, or signaling information'
18 U.S.C. §3127(4) — trap and trace expanded to include internet routing
civil_remedy_unchanged: No civil damages provision added — criminal-only enforcement retained
